research_question: Can a successful source program be migrated more reliably or cheaply by preserving task-stage semantics and adapting only embodiment-dependent stages?

manual_evaluation_only.note: Used after extraction for validation, not read by the extractor. Current target prompts omit validation metadata. The initial full-stage serialization inadvertently included a copy; the audit and corrected comparison are recorded separately.

phase3.local_repair_evidence: Cycle 2 changed only _stage_grasp; approach, lift, align, release and the fixed entrypoint retained identical AST hashes.
phase3.outcome: The stage-preserving execution and repair mechanism worked, but the generated grasp stage did not establish an official xArm6 grasp within the bounded pilot.

phase4.invalidation_reason: The gripper open/close directions supplied to all methods were reversed; this was corrected by measured finger-pad separation on 2026-10-23. Historical artifacts are retained unchanged.
phase4.outcome: The controlled three-method pipeline is executable and records identical metrics. No method achieved official StackCube success in this one-run pilot. Only the selective method preserved and reported a completed approach stage before localizing failure to grasp.
phase4.interpretation_limit: One independent generation run per method validates the protocol only and does not establish comparative superiority.

gripper_contract_correction.stationary_gripper_execution: Use _repeat_action; _move_towards(current_tcp) returns without sending a command.
gripper_contract_correction.manual_probe: Explicit close plus corrected endpoints produced official grasp before and after an approximately 8 cm lift at seed 0. This is a diagnostic intervention, not an LLM migration success.

cycles.reason: Only comments changed; AST repair validation rejected the candidate.

post_correction_selective_pilot.interpretation_limit: Stage completion uses generated stage predicates. It does not establish correct causal localization or robustness; overall official StackCube success remains false.

automatic_repair.reason: All generated repairs were semantically unchanged.

manual_diagnostic.provenance: Manual diagnostic stage replacements, not LLM migration results.

placement_followup.interpretation_limit: Single-seed diagnostics confirm physical feasibility and an actionable localization; automatic migration and generalization are not established.

automatic_method_repair.interpretation_limit: Resuming the same failed candidate in one physical scene; not from-scratch success or a scene-generalization estimate.

source_facts_comparison.interpretation_limit: Equal pilot success counts; lower action/token use for selective in this group only. Fixed scene, three generations per method, different information budgets, provider fallback enabled; no causal or generalization claim.

input_audit.issue: Initial full source-stage serialization included human validation labels, but no manual target solution code.
input_audit.resolution: Allowlist automatically extracted source facts; rerun one bounded primary group without validation or input_evidence metadata.

next_decision: Do not expand to 20 tasks yet. Isolate repair granularity from the same failed candidate and identical state feedback before testing new scenes.
not_yet_established: stage extraction generalization beyond the StackCube source style
target grasp and placement robustness beyond the two-scene smoke test
multi-task and multi-robot fully automatic migration
selective migration advantage over baselines under repeated trials
